records.scope: Flask application implementing the www.thumbtack.com mirror: home search + category tiles, per-category near-me listings with the captured filter-question sidebars and Recommended/Highest rated/Most hires/Fastest response sort tabs, pro profiles (About/Services/Photos/Reviews/Credentials with rating distribution, review topics, business hours, payment methods, Top Pro status), the request-a-quote wizard that matches projects with the category's top pros and collects deterministic in-band quotes, hiring, completion and review submission, saved pros, messaging threads with category+keyword-aware deterministic pro replies, the account area (login/register/profile/projects/saved/messages), scored token-overlap site search, cost-guide pages (/p/...), the /prices index, services-near-me index, city pages, the Thumbtack Guarantee and How-it-works pages, and the Join-as-a-pro enrollment form.

Deterministic build-time seeder. All content rows come from the tracked source_data_*.json snapshots; benchmark users use a frozen bcrypt password hash at seed time, and the routes indexes are created with explicit SQL inside the app (PYTHONHASHSEED=0 plus the explicit index pass keep the SQLite seed byte-reproducible on every build).

The 16 mirrored service categories with their real upstream /k/<slug>/near-me h1s, descriptions, filter-question sets (captured from the rendered filter sidebar on 2026-09-26), right-rail quote-form questions, near-me groups, and cost-guide links.

177 real pro profiles captured from the rendered public profile pages on 2026-09-26: names, cities, ratings, review counts, Thumbtack hires, Top Pro status, response times from the right rail, payment methods, business hours, service attributes, review-topic tags, rating distributions, and per-pro review texts with their Details lines (bedrooms/bathrooms/service type/pets/frequency) and JSON-LD star ratings. Pro avatar and portfolio image ids reference the captured production CDN URLs in scraped_data/image_manifest.json.

26 cost guides captured from the public /p/ pages (titles, national price ranges, low/high-end ranges, price tables with their section headings, FAQ text), homepage city links, guarantee copy, how-it-works steps, the prices-page featured national averages, the services-near-me popular list, and the category-aware pro-reply pools written from the captured pro communication patterns.

Builds the three source_data_*.json snapshots from the raw Playwright harvest under scraped_data/harvest/ (card texts, filter DOM extractions, profile innerText + JSON-LD review data). Idempotent and deterministic; also emits scraped_data/image_manifest.json mapping every managed image to its real production CDN source URL.
Fetches every image listed in scraped_data/image_manifest.json from its captured production-next-images-cdn.thumbtack.com URL into static/images/. Idempotent; run after build_source_data.py.
Generates asset_inventory.json (byte lengths, SHA-256, source URLs) for every file under static/images/ and static/external_cache/, gated by scripts/check_asset_inventory.py during the Docker build.
Deterministic generator for tasks.jsonl (20 goal-style benchmark tasks, contributor keys only).
The Rise variable font served by fonts.thumbtack.com and referenced by the upstream stylesheets; attribution recorded in NOTICE.md.

1,159 real images fetched from production-next-images-cdn.thumbtack.com on 2026-09-26: pro avatars (width/320 aspect 1-1), project portfolio photos (width/640 webp), homepage hero and explore cards, and category icons from the homepage explore-menu capture. Every file's byte length, SHA-256 and source URL are recorded in asset_inventory.json.

21 Jinja templates replicating the upstream layout: sticky header with the real thumbtack wordmark SVG, navy #07344A hero with the search pill, category chip rows, pro cards with Top Pro/Great value/In high demand/Online now badges, the filter sidebar, pro profile tabs, quote wizard, project matches with quotes, account pages, cost-guide layouts, and the navy footer with city links.
